approach: Add one pure function, `undecided_surface_changes(&SurfaceDiff, &[S]) -> Vec<String>`, and a constant `DECISION_LOG` to crates/athena-core/src/design_surface.rs. It returns one finding line per surface kind with changes, unless the changed paths include docs/decisions.md or the diff is empty. A unit test builds two `SurfaceInventory` values directly, runs the existing `diff`, and checks the flagged and unflagged outcomes. Then fill OLY-A-12 in docs/spec.toml (mechanism naming the function, owner Athena, measure ending `status: not shown` and naming the test), add an Unreleased/Added line to CHANGELOG.md, and append D172 to docs/decisions.md. Nothing is wired into landing, admission or `athena status`. This revision adds the missing seam for criterion 3: the demonstration names the three workspace checks as its entry points, the repository's real files as the fixture, and says the seam exists today.

decisions.choice: The check is a pure function over a SurfaceDiff and a list of changed paths; it does not call git.
decisions.reason: `diff` (design_surface.rs:722) already yields added, removed and changed items per kind, and `SurfaceInventory` derives Default with public BTreeMap fields (crates/athena-data/src/records/design_surface.rs:12-26), so a test can build inventories without a repository. The caller supplies the paths, so later wiring is one call.

rejected.option: A function taking a Git and two commits that computes the inventories and changed paths itself
rejected.why: It repeats `inventory_at` and `diff` and needs a git fixture for each case. The pure form covers the same rule and is smaller.

rejected.option: Wire it into landing or `athena status` now
rejected.why: Out of scope. Wiring adds a refusal and a status label, and no existing status line fits.

decisions.choice: A design decision means the change touches docs/decisions.md. The findings are one line per kind with changes, built from `SurfaceDiff::kinds()` (design_surface.rs:635) and `KindDiff::total()` (608).
decisions.reason: This is the reading the user accepted. It judges structure, not intent, as D162 does for the mirrors.

rejected.option: Parse the new D-entries and require one to name the changed item
rejected.why: That judges intent, which the accepted reading did not ask for.

decisions.choice: The measure is `status: not shown` and names `cargo test -p athena-core design_surface`.
decisions.reason: xtask/tests/spec.rs:190-207 requires the measure to end with `status: <label>`, and hestia accepts `not shown`. The check is not wired into anything `athena status` prints, so no label fits. This is the OLY-A-09 precedent.

rejected.why: It needs wiring and a status.rs change, both out of scope.

decisions.choice: Append D172 to docs/decisions.md with no `[[link]]` or `[[governs]]` entry.
decisions.reason: The brief lists decisions.md as a deliverable. The DecisionEntries and AppendOnly mirror rules require the next id, a well-formed heading, a Provenance bullet and an unchanged prefix. design_surface.rs is not governed in docs/decision-links.toml.

rejected.why: It is an expected deliverable, and the change records a design choice.

decisions.choice: Criterion 3 is demonstrated through the three workspace checks, with the repository's real docs/spec.toml, docs/decisions.md and sources as the fixture.
decisions.reason: xtask/tests/spec.rs and the mirrors tests read those files from disk, so they are the seam. The logic under test is the production parsing and rule code, not a double.

rejected.option: Add a separate fixture or double for the workspace checks
rejected.why: Not needed, since the real files are the input, and it would put logic into the double.

steps: In crates/athena-core/src/design_surface.rs, add `pub const DECISION_LOG: &str = "docs/decisions.md";` beside the path constants (lines 31-40). Add a module-doc bullet. After `diff` (after line 734) add `pub fn undecided_surface_changes<S: AsRef<str>>(changes: &SurfaceDiff, changed_paths: &[S]) -> Vec<String>`. It returns an empty Vec when `changes.is_empty()` or when any path, after trimming a leading `./`, equals DECISION_LOG. Otherwise it returns one line per entry of `changes.kinds()` with a non-zero `total()`, formatted like `commands: 1 added, 0 removed, 0 changed, with no entry in docs/decisions.md`.

In the `tests` module (line 773), add `a_surface_change_without_a_decision_is_reported_and_one_with_it_is_not`. Build `old` and `new` `SurfaceInventory` values by inserting into the BTreeMaps: a new command, a removed crate, a changed role version. Assert (a) three findings naming commands, roles and crates when the paths are `crates/a/src/lib.rs` only, (b) an empty list when `docs/decisions.md` is added to the paths, (c) an empty list for `diff(&old, &old)` with paths that exclude the log.
Run `cargo test -p athena-core design_surface`. Temporarily make the function body return `Vec::new()`, confirm assertion (a) fails, then restore the body.

In docs/spec.toml, replace the OLY-A-12 `mechanism = "none"` line with a mechanism naming `undecided_surface_changes` in crates/athena-core/src/design_surface.rs. Say it returns a finding per surface kind (commands, flags, config keys, record schemas, roles, crates) changed between two inventories when the changed paths exclude docs/decisions.md, and that it is a library check not wired into landing. Keep owner = "Athena". Replace the measure with one ending `status: not shown`, e.g. `Shown by the tests of cargo test -p athena-core design_surface: a surface change without docs/decisions.md among the changed paths is reported, and one with it, or none, is not; status: not shown`.

Append entry `## D172 · ...` after the last line of docs/decisions.md, in the D171 layout (lines 4944-4966): Case, Decision, Alternatives, Tradeoff, Reversal cost, Provenance. Provenance says what was read (design_surface.rs, the OLY-A-09 precedent, the hestia label check) and what was measured (the new test), that no reading rule changed so no share of newly refused readings applies, and that wiring is a follow-up. Do not edit earlier lines.

Add a bullet at the top of `### Added` under `## [Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md, in the OLY-A-09 style (lines 12-16), naming the function, the test command and that the measure stays `status: not shown`.
Run `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked`, and fix any finding.
